description: SynthScan benchmark corpus. Human samples are natural writing with personal detail and varied rhythm. AI samples emulate realistic MODERN language-model output (balanced, structured, generic) rather than obvious filler-bomb text, since that is what the detector must handle in practice. This is intentionally harder than a 4-sample sanity check.
